actor_llm._comment: actor 只输出 JSON action, 不需要 grounding, 用 flash 快 3-5 倍 (4-27 性能优化)

agent.task: Search for the keyword 'hello' in Lark (飞书) message history. Follow these steps in order, and execute exactly one action per step. Step 1: Use the run_apple_script action with script='tell application "Lark" to activate' to force Lark to the foreground. Step 2: Use multi_Hotkey action with key1='cmd' and key2='k' to open the Lark global search dialog. Step 3: Use input_text action with text='hello' to type the search keyword into the search box. Step 4: Look at the screen carefully. The Lark search results should now display matching items grouped by category (contacts, groups, messages). The task is complete when the search results contain at least one message item that includes the keyword 'hello'. If you can clearly see a message result containing 'hello', mark the task as done.
